regime.summary: Policy rate held at 11.0% and the 6M bill cutoff sits at the policy rate, so the curve prices no move. CPI has risen from 2.99% to 6.16% in three months, which removes the case for a near cut. KMI is up 38.3% in 12 months, so the market is not cheap. Hold-phase base rate is mildly positive (62% hit at 60 sessions). Stay invested but modest.

evidence.quote: Policy rate 11.0%; last MPC decision 2025-10-27: hold (+0bp)
6M T-bill minus policy rate -0.00pp (market near policy rate); CPI rising over 3 months (+3.2pp)

core.thesis: Fertilizer with its own catalyst: P/E 5.5 and dividend yield 11.2%, within 1.4% of its 252-day high. The 2024 first-cut episode had fertilizer and E&P leading while banks lagged. Income cushions a rate surprise.

evidence.quote: fertilizer, E&P and pharma led while banks lagged

core.thesis: E&P at its 252-day high with P/E 5.6 and yield 6.8%. E&P sector has 2 of 3 names at highs. Breakout-from-high cohort shows a 62% hit rate (suggestive only). Brent is down 8.5%, which is the risk I hold.
Fertilizer, 4.2% below its high, yield 10.5%, P/E 9.6. Net institutional flow into fertilizer by mutual funds is positive over 20 sessions. Smaller weight because Q3 EPS fell 32% year on year.
